Message.Name: Derivative Directory Message

Field.Description: Internal System tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique symbol assigned to the underlying security within the Exchange System.

Field.Name: Tradable
Field.Description: Tradable

Field.Name: MPV
Field.Description: Minimum Price Variation

Message.Name: Single Side Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a Side order is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Complex Strategy ID in case of a leg execution. Not supported on ISE or MRX Options at this time. Always set to '0'.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The order reference number associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Volume
Field.Description: The total quantity executed

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition as defined in the OPRA specification.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed With Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an incoming Side order is executed against the book in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Options Directory Message.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Complex Strategy ID in case of a leg execution. Not supported on MRX, GEMX or ISE Options at this time. Always set to 'O'.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The order reference number associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Printable

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution quantity.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition as defined in the OPRA specification.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Message.Name: Net Order Imbalance Message
Message.Description: This message is used to announce opening and re-opening auctions only.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument Id assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction Type

Field.Name: Paired Quantity
Field.Description: The total amount that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Side/Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Indicates the market side of the imbalance in case of Opening or the direction of the auction in case of Auction

Field.Name: Price/Imbalance Price
Field.Description: Price in fixed point format with 6 whole number places followed by 4 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Imbalance Volume
Field.Description: Imbalance volume for opening auction. Will be 0 for other auctions

Field.Name: Order Capacity
Field.Description: Will be provided with blank space for opening and reopening Auction.
